facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports the Bank of Algeria authorized Djezzy Payment Services to incorporate as a payment service provider on 23 September 2026, with a licence still required before operating, under Regulation No. 25-02 of April 2025 setting incorporation, licensing and operating requirements.

DZA.note: Document states no consumer-protection rules or complaints body.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
Transaction and merchant counts only; no survey of adults with accounts.
Online and terminal card payment figures only; no mobile money or e-money service in service is stated, Djezzy PSP not yet licensed.
Document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
